name: Georgia: individual entrepreneurs with small business status
dueNote: Small business status holders declare and pay 1% of turnover monthly, by the 15th of the following month.

presets.label: Small business status: 1% of turnover, no VAT
Small business status registered for VAT: VAT 18% + 1% of turnover

notes: The 1% regime applies up to the annual turnover limit of the status (GEL 500,000); above it the general regime applies. VAT registration is required above GEL 100,000 of turnover.
Rule packs are information, not tax advice. The user confirms the percentages; the vault enforces what the user chose.
